name: samkari-plugins
description: Mohammad Samkari's Claude plugins marketplace: a growing collection of plugins and projects.

plugins.name: persistent-memory
plugins.description: Build and run a Persistent Memory System for long-running projects so Claude stops asking you to re-explain context.

plugins.name: baton
plugins.description: Turn scattered context into a unified, shareable Structured Handover Document (case, project, or trip).

plugins.name: vitals
plugins.description: Offline, config-driven continuity check for any project: required files, fact expiry, state files fresher than work, and drift between derived files and their sources.

plugins.name: clipscope
plugins.description: Let Claude watch a public video or local clip: frames, audio and an optional local transcript, with loudness and silence metrics. Uses the yt-dlp, ffmpeg and whisper you already have.

plugins.name: nightshift
plugins.description: Usage-gated auto-resume: keep unfinished work moving with a queue file and a scheduled run that stops itself when your plan limit is near. Skills only, local work only.

plugins.name: lahja
plugins.description: Dialect-pack linter for spoken-word scripts: finds what sounds wrong when read aloud; first pack: Saudi (Gulf). Add your own dialect as a pack file. Read-only.

plugins.name: lahja-voice
plugins.description: Dry-run-first ElevenLabs voiceover from spoken-word scripts. Nothing is sent until you approve; the key comes from your environment only.

plugins.name: loom
plugins.description: Content-pipeline orchestrator. One config per project (formats, stages, gates, channels), an explicit per-item ledger, deterministic gates (commands such as a dialect linter, facts expiry, required files, ticked checklists), configured build and draft-staging adapters, and publish or schedule only after a recorded approval. Dry-run adoption with snapshot, shadow mode and rollback. Python standard library only.

plugins.name: relay
plugins.description: Pending-work registry for background agents and tasks. Everything needed to continue after a usage limit (HTTP 429) is saved in the project: a strict registry, the full brief of each agent, partial-report pointers and retry times. A fresh session lists what is due and re-launches from the saved briefs (a stopped subagent cannot be resumed from another session). Optional guarded ship step (pr, merge-ff, tag, release) that runs only pinned commands under a signed, expiring, commit-bound approval. Python standard library only.

plugins.name: ctxguard
plugins.description: Context-size guard hooks for Claude Code. Measures the live session context and age from the transcript and nudges you to hand over to a fresh session at soft and strong thresholds; opt-in blocking. No model, no network, Python standard library only.
